text:
maria: Heads-up — partner freight hold at EU port for the trial racks. carrier says hold until customs clears; estimated 72h delay. we need a plan for the pilot customers tomorrow.

tariq: ugh. which racks? can we swap from our staging pool in us-west?

maria: 12 racks destined for EU-dedicated pilot (order #RC-9812). staging pool has 6 spare, not enough for the full pilot.

olivia: can partner do partial split? get 6 now, rest on next flight? i asked them, waiting reply.

jordan: if we only can get 6, what's the customer expectation? can pilot run at reduced capacity?

maria: product said reduced capacity ok for one customer but contract for two pilots expects parallel runs. legal flagged SLA implications.

tariq: ok options: 1) redistribute current EU pool to prioritize pilot A, 2) air-bridge from us-west for remaining racks (fast but costy), 3) delay second pilot and offer credits.

olivia: partner offered to re-reroute 4 racks via expedited customs channel but needs supporting docs from us (commercial invoice amendment). could cover 4 more.
supply-bot: [log] inventory_check --pool=staging-us-west --available=6
supply-bot: [log] inventory_check --pool=eu-warehouse --available=8
jordan: math: 6 (staging) + 4 (partner expedite) = 10 vs 12 needed. still short 2.
maria: i can push legal to accept a temporary carve for pilot B to start in reduced mode, but ops needs a mitigation note for customers.
tariq: what's the incremental cost if we air-bridge 2 racks? ballpark?
olivia: carrier quoted $18k per rack expedited (2 racks = $36k). finance needs sign-off.
jordan: propose: move 6 from staging -> EU, accept partner expedite for 4, and ask pilot B to run at 10/12 capacity with temporary credit and a clear go-live window. keep air-bridge as fallback if pilot B needs full capacity.
maria: agree. i'll draft the customer comms and the credit note. olivia pls get the commercial invoice updated and confirm partner can do the expedite by EOD. tariq pls confirm staging move logistics and ETA. jordan pls prepare the customer-facing timeline.
olivia: on it, pinging partner now @carrier-contact (cc: @customs-broker).
tariq: staging move: can do same-day pickup, transit ~18h to EU consolidation hub, then 12h to customer site. will post tracking.
jordan: i'll draft a short note: "Due to a temporary customs hold affecting inbound racks, we'll provision the pilot at slightly reduced capacity. You will receive a credit for the impacted period. Expected full capacity by <date+5d>."
maria: thanks. once partner confirms expedite and we have invoice, i'll escalate finance for the air-bridge approval if needed.
supply-bot: [alert] hold_status_change order RC-9812 -> status=HOLD at 1768504355
maria: adding timeline checklist in thread: 1) partner confirm expedite (olivia) 2) invoice amendment submitted (olivia) 3) staging move scheduled (tariq) 4) customer comms ready (jordan) 5) finance fallback approval (maria)

maria: quick ask — can everyone react with :thumbsup: when their item is green so i can close this out in the partner channel.
